stem: Rourkela Steel Plant gets its supplies of iron ore from
expl: Rourkela Steel Plant is located on the main Mumbai-Kolkata S.E. Railway line in Sundergarh district, Odisha. The Rourkela Steel Plant was set up with the help of the German company Krupps and Demag. It began production in 1959. It is located near limestone, dolomite and manganese ore deposits. This plant obtains iron ore from Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar, Sundergarh etc,. Significantly coal is obtained from Bokaro, Jharia and Talchar, limestone and dolomite from Birmitrapur, manganese ore from Noamundi and coking coal from Kargali coal washery. This plant gets cheaper hydropower from Hirakud.

stem: In which of the following industries is rock phosphate used ?
expl: Rock phosphate is primarily used in the fertilizer industry. It is a major source of phosphorus, which is an essential nutrient for plant growth. Rock phosphate is used to produce phosphate fertilizers such as single super phosphate (SSP) and di-ammonium phosphate (DAP). Phosphorus is one of the three primary nutrients for plants (nitrogen, phosphorus and Potassium) and therefore plays a crucial role in enhancing crop yield in the agricultural sector.

stem:
Consider the following statements :
1. Petronet LNG Ltd. is setting up another LNG terminal at Mangalore.
2. The Head Office of the Dredging Corporation of India is at Visakhapatnam.
3. The Narwapahar Mine is operated by the Uranium Corporation of India Limited.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
expl: The details are as follows: (1) Petronet LNG Ltd. is an Indian oil and gas company formed by the government of India to import liquefied natural gas (LNG) and set up LNG terminals in the country. It is a joint venture company promoted by the Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL), Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) with an authorized capital. Petronet LNG Ltd has set up its first LNG terminal at Dahej in Gujarat with a capacity of 17.5 million metric tonnes per year. Another terminal with a capacity of 5 million tonnes per year was commissioned in Kochi (Kerala). (2) The Head Office of the Dredging Corporation of India is strategically located on the eastern seaboard of India at Visakhapatnam. DCI helps to ensure the continuous availability of the desired depths in shipping channels of the major and minor ports, Navy, fishing harbors and other maritime organizations. The horizons of dredging activities are fast expanding worldwide, and its services are increasing in demand and are put to use in the areas of environmental protection, tourism, flood control, irrigation, power generation, port development, mining, laying of offshore pipelines and so on. (3) The Narwapahar Mine is the a trackless uranium mine located in Jharkhand which is being operated by the Uranium Corporation of India Limited.

options.label: b
options.text: Assertion is correct but reason is wrong.

options.label: c

expl: In India, cotton is mainly produced in black soils. Bhilwara iron ore mine is located in Rajasthan.
